pageDesc: Set your own Google PageSpeed and Gemini API keys locally for unlimited testing.
sub: Save your own API keys in this browser for unlimited tests without daily quota limits
speedPlaceholder: Paste your AIza... key from Google Cloud
geminiPlaceholder: Paste your AIza... key from Google AI Studio
clearedMsg: Keys cleared. Using 3/day free system quota.
statusUser: Unlimited Mode: using your own API Keys.
statusSystem: Free System Mode: max 3 tests per day (to save shared quota).
statusBlocked: Daily quota (3/3) reached. Add your own keys above or try tomorrow.
guideTitle: How to get your free API Keys in 1 minute
guideSpeedSteps: Click 'Get Key' (Google Developers) or open PageSpeed API in Cloud Console.
Click the blue 'Get a Key' button (or Enable API) and select or create a quick project.
Copy the generated AIza... key and paste it above.
guideGeminiSteps: Sign in with your Google account and click 'Create API key'.
Copy your AIza... key and paste it above.
